result.summary: Found 1 major issue: a missing or failed-to-load restaurant image in the 'Popular right now' section, displayed as a placeholder icon.

issues.description: Restaurant image in 'Popular right now' section shows a generic placeholder icon instead of actual restaurant photo. The image appears to have failed to load or is missing.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant image URL is correct and the image file loads properly. Implement error handling to display a fallback image or message if the primary image fails to load.
